lens.both: A finding that counts against both the ATS and the Accessibility check
lens.compile: The build and layout check, not a verb

severity.info: Lowest severity of a preflight finding, below warning

scores.ats: Short ring label for Applicant Tracking System readiness, keep it very short
scores.compile: Short ring label for the build check, keep it very short
scores.a11y: Short ring label for the accessibility check, keep it very short
scores.refs: Short ring label for references and assets, keep it very short
scores.submission: Short ring label for submission readiness, keep it very short
scores.privacy: Short ring label for privacy and blind review, keep it very short

panel.run: Button that starts one preflight check
panel.rerun: Button that runs a preflight check again
panel.collapse: Collapses one check card in the panel
panel.expand: Expands one check card in the panel
panel.groupSource: Heading over findings that come from the project source files
panel.groupOutput: Heading over findings that come from the compiled PDF

finding.review: Badge on an advisory finding that a person still has to judge
finding.manual: Badge on a finding that no tool can decide from the file alone
finding.page: Page marker shown after a dot, for example p.3

atsCard.notFound: Shown where a resume parser recovered no value for a field

prepExport.applied: Button label after the prepared source was written into the document
prepExport.copied: Button label after the prepared source was copied to the clipboard
